title: A local section of canonical derived evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$ and every open. Let $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, let $U$ be an open, and let $P$ be a complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules strictly perfect in the sense of [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Suppose given $e_K:RK\cong QP$, where $R$ is exact restriction. Put $H=R\mathcal Hom$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X[0])$, and use the derived tensor of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let $g:N\otimes^L D\to H(K,N)$ be the adjunct, for the fixed canonical family [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection], of the associator followed by $1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev}$ and the right unitor, where $\mathrm{ev}$ is the image of $1_D$ under that family. There exists $s:RH(K,N)\to R(N\otimes^L D)$ with $s;R(g)=1_{RH(K,N)}$. Only this one inverse identity is asserted; no representative of N or comparison with a prescribed chain map is an input or a conclusion.

source.place: Tag 08DQ, proof of lemma-dual-perfect-complex, ordinary complex models and comparison; Tag 08DM, lemma-Rhom-strictly-perfect; Tag 08DL, lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U

proof.text: Represent RN by a K-injective F. Restriction of derived internal Hom and its K-injective representative computation identify RH(K,N) with Q Hom(P,F).

Resolve O[0] and use the bounded exact-term Hom quasi-isomorphism calculation: finite-free retractions make internal Hom from each P term exact. This identifies the restricted derived dual with Hom(P,O[0]). In degree q its only nonzero factor is Hom(P^(-q),O). Dualizing the finite free inclusion and projection gives a finite free retraction of this term. The dual support is [-b,-a]; its terms are flat, so the dual is K-flat. Exact open restriction and the K-flat tensor computation give the source model Q Tot(F tensor Hom(P,O[0])).

The canonical tensor-Hom representative equation, followed by restriction, uncurries the adjunct on the (p,q) tensor summand. On the r-th Hom projection it evaluates the dual on P^r and applies the right unit action to F^p if r+q=0, and is zero otherwise. This is the ordinary evaluation formula; the tensor inclusions and Hom projections detect equality. Evaluation is degreewise invertible for strictly perfect P, hence is an isomorphism of complexes.

Take the inverse of ordinary evaluation and conjugate it by the target and source model isomorphisms. Its composite with evaluation is the identity after each Hom product projection; localizing and conjugating gives s;R(g)=1 on the target.

theorem exists_strictlyPerfect_evaluation_local_section (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (_hstrict : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (_eK : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) D K (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (𝟙 D)) ≫
          (ρ_ N).hom)
    ∃ s : R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)) ⟶ R.obj (N ⊗ D),
      s ≫ R.map g = 𝟙 (R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)))
